title: NLST paired CT reconstructions
summary: Two reconstruction kernels of one chest CT acquisition support a controlled pose-recovery task.
image_description: B30f and B50f CT volumes, matched on geometry and acquisition metadata.
annotation_description: Author-selected plane pose derived from source geometry.
reference_note: The known transform tests geometric recovery. It is not a clinical landmark or cross-acquisition registration reference.

sample_sets.label: Kernel pair
sample_sets.note: 139 matching slice positions; common projection acquisition is supported but not independently proven.

documentation_gaps: Projection IDs were not available to independently establish a common projection acquisition.
version_note: The linked pinned receipts identify the selected release and files; this is not a current upstream availability check.
